play_equipment.evidence: A round dark disc with a lighter rim, consistent with a trampoline, sits in the backyard just east of the house. A wooden structure that may be a play set or deck sits just above it.

signals.notes: The central house has a dark gray multi-gable roof and a paved driveway with a white vehicle to the north. A backyard trampoline is visible east of the house. Mature trees border the lot on the east and south.
